sentences.text: ----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Vaga Ram S/o Sh. Chunaram, R/o Lapsiya Fali Nichala  Goriya, Bali.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mukesh trivedi, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 17/01/2024 The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.199/2022 of Police Station Nana, Dist. Pali for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 306, 323, 324 IPC.
He has preferred this second bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
The first bail application was dismissed by this Court on 08.08.2023.

Counsel for the petitioner submits that the statements of witnesses Vagaram (PW.2) and Sarmi (PW.3) have been recorded before the trial court and there are material contradictions, omissions and improvements in their statements.
Counsel further submits that the children of the deceased gave statements before the police that no quarrel was taken place between their parents.
The accused- petitioner is inside jail since 10.11.2022 and the trial of the case will [2024:RJ-JD:2682] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-14520/2023] take sufficient long time to be concluded.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the second bail application.

sentences.text: Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

Accordingly, the second bail application filed under Sec.439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioner Mohan Lal S/o Chunaram shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No.199/2022 of Police Station Nana, Dist. Pali, provided he executes a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
